verses.en: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put every man’s money in his sack’s mouth.
verses.pt: Depois José deu ordem ao despenseiro de sua casa, dizendo: Enche de mantimento os sacos dos homens, quanto puderem levar, e põe o dinheiro de cada um na boca do seu saco.
verses.en_web: He commanded the steward of his house, saying, “Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put each man’s money in his sack’s mouth.
verses.en_bbe: Then he gave orders to the servant who was over his house, saying, Put as much food into the men's bags as will go into them, and put every man's money in the mouth of his bag;

verses.en: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack’s mouth of the youngest, and his corn money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.
verses.pt: E a minha taça de prata porãs na boca do saco do mais novo, com o dinheiro do seu trigo. Assim fez ele conforme a palavra que José havia dito.
verses.en_web: Put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack’s mouth of the youngest, with his grain money.” He did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.
verses.en_bbe: And put my cup, my silver cup, in the youngest one's bag, with his money. So he did as Joseph said.

verses.en: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.
verses.pt: Logo que veio a luz da manhã, foram despedidos os homens, eles com os seus jumentos.
verses.en_web: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their donkeys.
verses.en_bbe: And at dawn the men, with their asses, were sent away.

verses.en: And when they were gone out of the city, and not yet far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good?
verses.pt: Havendo eles saído da cidade, mas não se tendo distanciado muito, disse José ao seu despenseiro: Levanta-te e segue os homens; e, alcançando-os, dize-lhes: Por que tornastes o mal pelo bem?
verses.en_web: When they had gone out of the city, and were not yet far off, Joseph said to his steward, “Up, follow after the men. When you overtake them, ask them, ‘Why have you rewarded evil for good?
verses.en_bbe: And when they had gone only a little way out of the town, Joseph said to the servant who was over his house, Go after them; and when you overtake them, say to them, Why have you done evil in reward for good?

verses.en: Is not this it in which my lord drinketh, and whereby indeed he divineth? ye have done evil in so doing.
verses.pt: Não é esta a taça por que bebe meu senhor, e de que se serve para adivinhar? Fizestes mal no que fizestes.
verses.en_web: Isn’t this that from which my lord drinks, and by which he indeed divines? You have done evil in so doing.’”
verses.en_bbe: Is not this the cup from which my lord takes wine and by which he gets knowledge of the future? Truly, you have done evil.

verses.en: And he overtook them, and he spake unto them these same words.
verses.pt: Então ele, tendo-os alcançado, lhes falou essas mesmas palavras.
verses.en_web: He overtook them, and he spoke these words to them.
verses.en_bbe: So he overtook them and said these words to them.

verses.en: And they said unto him, Wherefore saith my lord these words? God forbid that thy servants should do according to this thing:
verses.pt: Responderam-lhe eles: Por que falo meu senhor tais palavras? Longe estejam teus servos de fazerem semelhante coisa.
verses.en_web: They said to him, “Why does my lord speak such words as these? Far be it from your servants that they should do such a thing!
verses.en_bbe: And they said to him, Why does my lord say such words as these? far be it from your servants to do such a thing:

verses.en: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks’ mouths, we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out of thy lord’s house silver or gold?
verses.pt: Eis que o dinheiro, que achamos nas bocas dos nossos sacos, to tornamos a trazer desde a terra de Canaã; como, pois, furtaríamos da casa do teu senhor prata ou ouro?
verses.en_web: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks’ mouths, we brought again to you out of the land of Canaan. How then should we steal silver or gold out of your lord’s house?
verses.en_bbe: See, the money which was in the mouth of our bags we gave back to you when we came again from Canaan: how then might we take silver or gold from your lord's house?

verses.en: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found, both let him die, and we also will be my lord’s bondmen.
verses.pt: Aquele dos teus servos com quem a taça for encontrada, morra; e ainda nós seremos escravos do meu senhor.
verses.en_web: With whomever of your servants it is found, let him die, and we also will be my lord’s slaves.”
verses.en_bbe: If it comes to light that any of your servants has done this, let him be put to death, and we will be your lord's servants.

verses.en: And he said, Now also let it be according unto your words; he with whom it is found shall be my servant; and ye shall be blameless.
verses.pt: Ao que disse ele: Seja conforme as vossas palavras; aquele com quem a taça for encontrada será meu escravo; mas vós sereis inocentes.
verses.en_web: He said, “Now also let it be according to your words: he with whom it is found will be my slave; and you will be blameless.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Let it be as you say: he in whose bag it is seen will become my servant; and you will not be responsible.

verses.en: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.
verses.pt: Então eles se apressaram cada um a pôr em terra o seu saco, e cada um a abri-lo.
verses.en_web: Then they hurried, and each man took his sack down to the ground, and each man opened his sack.
verses.en_bbe: Then every man quickly got his bag down and undid it.

verses.en: And he searched, and began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.
verses.pt: E o despenseiro buscou, começando pelo maior, e acabando pelo mais novo; e achou-se a taça no saco de Benjamim.
verses.en_web: He searched, beginning with the oldest, and ending at the youngest. The cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.
verses.en_bbe: And he made a search, starting with the oldest and ending with the youngest; and the cup was in Benjamin's bag.

verses.en: Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.
verses.pt: Então rasgaram os seus vestidos e, tendo cada um carregado o seu jumento, voltaram à cidade.
verses.en_web: Then they tore their clothes, and each man loaded his donkey, and returned to the city.
verses.en_bbe: Then in bitter grief they put the bags on the asses again and went back to the town.

verses.en: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph’s house; for he was yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.
verses.pt: E veio Judá com seus irmãos à casa de José, pois ele ainda estava ali; e prostraram-se em terra diante dele.
verses.en_web: Judah and his brothers came to Joseph’s house, and he was still there. They fell on the ground before him.
verses.en_bbe: So Judah and his brothers came to Joseph's house; and he was still there: and they went down on their faces before him.

verses.en: And Joseph said unto them, What deed is this that ye have done? wot ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine?
verses.pt: Logo lhes perguntou José: Que ação é esta que praticastes? não sabeis vós que um homem como eu pode, muito bem, adivinhar?
verses.en_web: Joseph said to them, “What deed is this that you have done? Don’t you know that such a man as I can indeed divine?”
verses.en_bbe: And Joseph said, What is this thing which you have done? had you no thought that such a man as I would have power to see what is secret?

verses.en: And Judah said, What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants: behold, we are my lord’s servants, both we, and he also with whom the cup is found.
verses.pt: Respondeu Judá: Que diremos a meu senhor? que falaremos? e como nos justificaremos? Descobriu Deus a iniqüidade de teus servos; eis que somos escravos de meu senhor, tanto nós como aquele em cuja mão foi achada a taça.
verses.en_web: Judah said, “What will we tell my lord? What will we speak? Or how will we clear ourselves? God has found out the iniquity of your servants. Behold, we are my lord’s slaves, both we, and he also in whose hand the cup is found.”
verses.en_bbe: And Judah said, What are we to say to my lord? how may we put ourselves right in his eyes? God has made clear the sin of your servants: now we are in your hands, we and the man in whose bag your cup was seen.

verses.en: And he said, God forbid that I should do so: but the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant; and as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.
verses.pt: Disse José: Longe esteja eu de fazer isto; o homem em cuja mão a taça foi achada, aquele será meu servo; porém, quanto a vós, subi em paz para vosso pai.
verses.en_web: He said, “Far be it from me that I should do so. The man in whose hand the cup is found, he will be my slave; but as for you, go up in peace to your father.”
verses.en_bbe: Then he said, Far be it from me to do so: but the man who had my cup will be my servant; and you may go back to your father in peace.

verses.en: Then Judah came near unto him, and said, Oh my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord’s ears, and let not thine anger burn against thy servant: for thou art even as Pharaoh.
verses.pt: Então Judà se chegou a ele, e disse: Ai! senhor meu, deixa, peço-te, o teu servo dizer uma palavra aos ouvidos de meu senhor; e não se acenda a tua ira contra o teu servo; porque tu és como Faraó.
verses.en_web: Then Judah came near to him, and said, “Oh, my lord, please let your servant speak a word in my lord’s ears, and don’t let your anger burn against your servant; for you are even as Pharaoh.
verses.en_bbe: Then Judah came near him, and said, Let your servant say a word in my lord's ears, and let not your wrath be burning against your servant: for you are in the place of Pharaoh to us.

verses.en: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have ye a father, or a brother?
verses.pt: Meu senhor perguntou a seus servos, dizendo: Tendes vós pai, ou irmão?
verses.en_web: My lord asked his servants, saying, ‘Have you a father, or a brother?’
verses.en_bbe: My lord said to his servants, Have you a father or a brother?

verses.en: And we said unto my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loveth him.
verses.pt: E respondemos a meu senhor: Temos pai, já velho, e há um filho da sua velhice, um menino pequeno; o irmão deste é morto, e ele ficou o único de sua mãe; e seu pai o ama.
verses.en_web: We said to my lord, ‘We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother; and his father loves him.’
verses.en_bbe: And we said to my lord, We have an old father and a young child, whom he had when he was old; his brother is dead and he is the only son of his mother, and is very dear to his father.

verses.en: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Bring him down unto me, that I may set mine eyes upon him.
verses.pt: Então tu disseste a teus servos: Trazei-mo, para que eu ponha os olhos sobre ele.
verses.en_web: You said to your servants, ‘Bring him down to me, that I may set my eyes on him.’
verses.en_bbe: And you said to your servants, Let him come down to me with you, so that I may see him.

verses.en: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.
verses.pt: E quando respondemos a meu senhor: O menino não pode deixar o seu pai; pois se ele deixasse o seu pai, este morreria;
verses.en_web: We said to my lord, ‘The boy can’t leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.’
verses.en_bbe: And we said to my lord, His father will not let him go; for if he went away his father would come to his death.

verses.en: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.
verses.pt: replicaste a teus servos: A menos que desça convosco vosso irmão mais novo, nunca mais vereis a minha face.
verses.en_web: You said to your servants, ‘Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you will see my face no more.’
verses.en_bbe: But you said to your servants, If your youngest brother does not come with you, you will not see my face again.

verses.en: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.
verses.pt: Então subimos a teu servo, meu pai, e lhe contamos as palavras de meu senhor.
verses.en_web: When we came up to your servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.
verses.en_bbe: And when we went back to your servant, our father, we gave him an account of my lord's words.

verses.en: And our father said, Go again, and buy us a little food.
verses.pt: Depois disse nosso pai: Tornai, comprai-nos um pouco de mantimento;
verses.en_web: Our father said, ‘Go again and buy us a little food.’
verses.en_bbe: And our father said, Go again and get us a little food.

verses.en: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man’s face, except our youngest brother be with us.
verses.pt: e lhe respondemos: Não podemos descer; mas, se nosso irmão menor for conosco, desceremos; pois não podemos ver a face do homem, se nosso irmão menor não estiver conosco.
verses.en_web: We said, ‘We can’t go down. If our youngest brother is with us, then we will go down: for we may not see the man’s face, unless our youngest brother is with us.’
verses.en_bbe: And we said, Only if our youngest brother goes with us will we go down; for we may not see the man's face again if our youngest brother is not with us.

verses.en: And thy servant my father said unto us, Ye know that my wife bare me two sons:
verses.pt: Então nos disse teu servo, meu pai: Vós sabeis que minha mulher me deu dois filhos;
verses.en_web: Your servant, my father, said to us, ‘You know that my wife bore me two sons:
verses.en_bbe: And our father said to us, You have knowledge that my wife gave me two sons;

verses.en: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I saw him not since:
verses.pt: um saiu de minha casa e eu disse: certamente foi despedaçado, e não o tenho visto mais;
verses.en_web: and the one went out from me, and I said, “Surely he is torn in pieces”; and I haven’t seen him since.
verses.en_bbe: The one went away from me, and I said, Truly he has come to a violent death; and from that time I have not seen him,

verses.en: And if ye take this also from me, and mischief befall him, ye shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.
verses.pt: se também me tirardes a este, e lhe acontecer algum desastre, fareis descer as minhas cãs com tristeza ao Seol.
verses.en_web: If you take this one also from me, and harm happens to him, you will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.’
verses.en_bbe: If now you take this one from me, and some evil comes to him, you will make my grey head go down in sorrow to the underworld.

verses.en: Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad be not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad’s life;
verses.pt: Agora, pois, se eu for ter com o teu servo, meu pai, e o menino não estiver conosco, como a sua alma está ligada com a alma dele,
verses.en_web: Now therefore when I come to your servant my father, and the boy is not with us; since his life is bound up in the boy’s life;
verses.en_bbe: If then I go back to your servant, my father, without the boy, because his life and the boy's life are one,

verses.en: It shall come to pass, when he seeth that the lad is not with us, that he will die: and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave.
verses.pt: acontecerá que, vendo ele que o menino ali não está, morrerá; e teus servos farão descer as cãs de teu servo, nosso pai com tristeza ao Seol.
verses.en_web: it will happen, when he sees that the boy is no more, that he will die. Your servants will bring down the gray hairs of your servant, our father, with sorrow to Sheol.
verses.en_bbe: When he sees that the boy is not with us, he will come to his death, and our father's grey head will go down in sorrow to the underworld.

verses.en: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, If I bring him not unto thee, then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever.
verses.pt: Porque teu servo se deu como fiador pelo menino para com meu pai, dizendo: Se eu to não trouxer de volta, serei culpado, para com meu pai para sempre.
verses.en_web: For your servant became collateral for the boy to my father, saying, ‘If I don’t bring him to you, then I will bear the blame to my father forever.’
verses.en_bbe: For I made myself responsible for the boy to my father, saying, If I do not give him safely back to you, let mine be the sin for ever.

verses.en: Now therefore, I pray thee, let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.
verses.pt: Agora, pois, fique teu servo em lugar do menino como escravo de meu senhor, e que suba o menino com seus irmãos.
verses.en_web: Now therefore, please let your servant stay instead of the boy, my lord’s slave; and let the boy go up with his brothers.
verses.en_bbe: So now let me be my lord's servant here in place of the boy, and let him go back with his brothers.

verses.en: For how shall I go up to my father, and the lad be not with me? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father.
verses.pt: Porque, como subirei eu a meu pai, se o menino não for comigo? para que não veja eu o mal que sobrevirá a meu pai.
verses.en_web: For how will I go up to my father, if the boy isn’t with me?—lest I see the evil that will come on my father.”
verses.en_bbe: For how may I go back to my father without the boy, and see the evil which will come on my father?
